ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The velocity of the electron is $v=3.0 \times 10^6 \mathrm{m/s}$, and it is injected into a uniform magnetic field of $B=0.10 \mathrm{T}$ in a direction perpendicular to the magnetic field.

1. What is the magnitude of the Lorentz force experienced by the electron?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The velocity of the electron is $v=3.0 \times 10^6 \mathrm{m/s}$, and it is injected into a uniform magnetic field of $B=0.10 \mathrm{T}$ in a direction perpendicular to the magnetic field. 1. What is the magnitude of the Lorentz force experienced by the electron?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Given v = 3.0 × 10^6 m/s and B = 0.10 T. The electron is injected perpendicular to the magnetic field, so θ = 90° and sin θ = 1. The magnetic Lorentz force magnitude is F = |q_e| v B sin θ. Use the magnitude of the electron charge, |q_e| = 1.60 × 10^-19 C. Thus F = (1.60 × 10^-19)(3.0 × 10^6)(0.10) = 4.8 × 10^-14 N.
